say:2:1064401001:0.source_cn: 是阿尔娜将军，她回来啦！

say:4:1064401002:0.text: Thanks to Alna, the wolves and bandits are kept at bay. <style="highlight">Resford</style> will enjoy another peaceful winter this year!
say:4:1064401002:0.source_cn: 诸神保佑，多亏了阿尔娜，北地的狼群和匪患才不敢靠近<s...

say:5:1064401003:0.text: General Alna! When I grow up, I want to be a hero just like you!
say:5:1064401003:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜将军！我以后也要像您一样，骑着大马，拿着长枪，保...

say:6:1064401004:0.text: The little girl dashes toward Alna excitedly, only for her mother to pull her back with an apologetic smile.
say:6:1064401004:0.source_cn: 孩童兴奋地冲到阿尔娜身前，身后的母亲急忙拉住她，对阿尔...

say:10:1064401005:1.text: Little one, that dream can wait. You're still young, so stay close to your mother, alright?
say:10:1064401005:1.source_cn: 小家伙，握紧武器之前，先学会抓牢母亲的手。

say:11:1064401006:1.text: One day, when you've grown up and trained hard, you'll be strong enough to protect Resford.
say:11:1064401006:1.source_cn: 然后努力变强，安息城需要每一份力量。

say:13:1064401007:0.text: Alna rides past the welcoming crowd atop her mount. As she enters the city, a high-ranking official steps forward to greet her.
say:13:1064401007:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜驱马穿过欢迎她的人群，未曾停留。入城后，一位高官迎来。

say:16:1064401008:0.text: Congratulations on your victory, General Alna! Not even the blizzards could hold you back!
say:16:1064401008:0.source_cn: 祝贺将军凯旋，看来北地的风雪，又一次为您让出了道路。

say:17:1064401009:0.text: Lord Sno sends his regards and has entrusted me with the rewards he prepared for you. General, please have a—
say:17:1064401009:0.source_cn: 领主大人本想亲自迎接，只是近日为城邦事务辛劳过度，此刻...

say:18:1064401010:0.text:
Dunn, take inventory.
See to the families of the fallen first, then distribute the rest to the soldiers based on merit.
say:18:1064401010:0.source_cn: 邓恩，全部登记。\n按军功分给出征士兵，尤其是阵亡者的遗属。

say:22:1064401012:0.text: W-Wait... General, these rewards are meant for you alone. It wouldn't be appropriate to give them away.
say:22:1064401012:0.source_cn: 这……将军，这是领主大人对您一人的赏赐，于礼不合。

say:23:1064401013:0.text:
This is what I've always done.
My duties await. Please excuse me.
say:23:1064401013:0.source_cn: 这是惯例。\n军队有待巡视，不奉陪了。

say:24:1064401014:0.text: General, your dedication is certainly admirable, but I've prepared a banquet in your honor this evening. Once Lord Sno awakens...
say:24:1064401014:0.source_cn: 将军忠于职守，无可指摘。只是鞍马劳顿，我已备下晚宴，待...

say:28:1064401016:0.text: At dusk, two soldiers stand guard at the Resford's eastern gate. One of them, finding the cold unbearable, prepares to leave.
say:28:1064401016:0.source_cn: 傍晚时分，安息城东门，两名执勤士兵挺立，其中一人搓了搓...

say:30:1064401017:0.text: Raymond, we can't leave our post until the relief arrives.
say:30:1064401017:0.source_cn: 莱默尔，换岗的人还没来，按军规，不能随便离开城门。

say:32:1064401018:1.text: Um... I was only checking whether our replacements were on their way. Relax, the enemy won't be coming out in weather like this...
say:32:1064401018:1.source_cn: 呃……我就是打算去营里催一声，大冷天的，敌人不会碰巧在...

say:36:1064401019:0.source_cn: 大人——城里的大人们！行行好，放我们进城吧！

say:37:1064401020:0.text: Who's there?! Step into the light so I can see you! How many of you are there? Is anyone ill?
say:37:1064401020:0.source_cn: 谁？！站到火光里来，让我看清人数！有没有人身患疾病？

say:38:1064401021:0.text: <style="highlight">Hypofiends</style>! There are Hypofiends right behind us!!! Please let us in! We just need a shelter!

say:39:1064401022:0.text: Hypofiend? What's that? Raymond, keep an eye on them. I'll notify General Alna.
say:39:1064401022:0.source_cn: 魔物？那是什么？莱默尔，看好他们，我去通报阿尔娜将军。

say:44:1064401024:1.text:
Keep your head up, sir.
Could you tell me about yourself? And what exactly is a Hypofiend?
say:44:1064401024:1.source_cn: 老人家，抬起头来。\n说清楚，你们来自哪里？途径何处？...

say:45:1064401025:1.text:
Madam, we're from Buckham in the south.
Buckham, Macyland, and Castleville... They're all gone! We kept running north, and didn't stop until we made it here.
say:45:1064401025:1.source_cn: 大人，我们是南边巴克村的。\n村子，还有梅卡镇、卡索城...

say:46:1064401026:1.text: Those Hypofiends... Some had horns, while others crawled straight out of the ground. They slaughtered everyone they saw, and our farm tools couldn't even leave a scratch on them!
say:46:1064401026:1.source_cn: 那些魔物，有的长角，有的从地底下钻出来，见到人就杀，农...

say:47:1064401027:1.text: Please, let us in... I'm begging you.
say:47:1064401027:1.source_cn: 求求大人，放我们进城吧……

say:48:1064401028:1.text:
Russell, open the gate. Give them soup and blankets.
I don't think they're dangerous. No enemy would send the elderly and children to scout ahead in weather like this.
say:48:1064401028:1.source_cn: 罗塞，放他们进城，分发热汤和毛毯。\n若是敌军伪装，不...

say:49:1064401029:1.text: Dunn, dispatch three scout teams to Buckham, Macyland, and Castleville tonight. I want a full report on the situation.
say:49:1064401029:1.source_cn: 邓恩，派三队斥候，今夜出城，到巴克村、梅卡镇、卡索城，...

say:55:1064401031:0.text: And Raymond, your shift is extended until dawn.
say:55:1064401031:0.source_cn: 莱默尔，你的值守时间延长到天明。

say:56:1064401032:0.text: Remember, the city gates are the heart of Resford. There's no place in my army for soldiers who neglect their duty.
say:56:1064401032:0.source_cn: 记住，城门是安息城的心脏，军队不需要疏忽职守的士兵！

say:57:1064401033:1.text: I'm sorry, General! I'll keep that in mind!
say:57:1064401033:1.source_cn: 对不起，将军，我以后不会再犯！
